title: Student procession for safe schooling and education funding
location: MIUR / viale Trastevere to Piazza della Rotonda (Pantheon), Rome

occurrence.note: Repubblica reports an actual afternoon student procession and convergence at Pantheon.

demand.note: Demands on the national government for school safety, space, transport and funding to protect public education.

onset.note: One-day event, reported Dec18; continuation from other months not established.

violence.note: Student and police accounts conflict over use of force; uncertainty preserved.
